row.evidence: Honeycomb's pricing page lists Single-Sign On (SSO) on Pro and its docs cover SAML SSO with Okta and Entra ID (accounts created on first login), but neither the pricing page, the docs index, the full docs export nor the public OpenAPI spec mention SCIM.
row.notes: New row. Usage-priced with unlimited seats: Free (up to 20M events/month), Pro starting at $150/month (monthly or annual), Enterprise custom; per-user fields stay null. SAML SSO (Okta, Entra ID, other SAML 2.0 IdPs) and Google SSO are on Pro and Enterprise. No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere: users are created just-in-time on first SAML login, and Team Owners invite, remove and change roles in the UI. The Okta OIN app is SAML only; Entra uses a non-gallery app. The public API (v1 data/config, v2 team API keys and environments) has no user or member endpoints. The Activity Log (audit) is Enterprise-only and exportable as CSV. None by absence, medium confidence.

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation found; the 896 KB full docs export (llms-full.txt) contains no mention of SCIM.

audit_log_api.notes: Activity Log is an Enterprise-only environment (API key changes, user logins and more) with a 60-day CSV export; no dedicated audit-log endpoint is documented.

user_api.notes: The public OpenAPI spec (docs.honeycomb.io/api/openapi-public.yaml) covers datasets, boards, queries, triggers, SLOs, markers and v2 team API keys and environments; it has no user, member or role endpoints. Member management is UI-only per the docs.

okta.notes: The OIN page's functionality list checks SAML only; SCIM and provisioning actions are unchecked.

entra.notes: Honeycomb's Entra guide uses a non-gallery enterprise application; learn.microsoft.com honeycomb-tutorial returns 404.

google.notes: Google SSO (sign in with Google) is supported but is not SAML and no Workspace Marketplace app was checked.

fallbacks.notes: Team Owners invite, remove and change roles of members in the UI.
